arguments.text:
Marta, I am right here with you, and it makes sense that you feel scared. You did well to sit down instead of pushing through. Here are some sensible next steps.

1) Stay safe right now: stay seated on the floor or move slowly to a sturdy chair only if you feel steady. Keep your phone and pendant within reach. Take a few sips of water if you have not had much today.

2) Call 911 or press your pendant right away if any of these happen: chest pain, trouble breathing, weakness on one side, fainting or nearly fainting, confusion, black stools, fever with confusion, being unable to get up or walk, or pain from a new fall.

3) Your care summary says that new or worsening pain together with unusual tiredness should get same-day guidance from Dr. Leung's team. If you want, I can draft a short DoctorConnect message to the clinic (careteam@maple-grove-clinic.example.org) for you to review before anything is sent. It would say you had aching pain and got tired and shaky, sat on the floor, and did not fall. Or you could call the clinic's nurse line yourself.

4) While you decide, note where the pain is, when it started, and whether this tiredness is worse than your usual after-lunch sleepiness. Please avoid chores or long walks for now.

5) If you would like someone to check in, I can help you word a calm note to Elena, such as: "I am having a slow day, but I am safe and resting. I would like a quick check-in later."

What would you like to do? I will not contact anyone unless you tell me to. How are you feeling right now?

arguments.subject: Same-day triage request - Marta Alvarez
arguments.body:
Hello Dr. Leung's team,

Marta reports new aching pain in the bathroom, followed by unusual fatigue and shakiness. She sat down on the bathroom floor. She reports no fall and no head strike, and she can reach her phone and pendant. Please review for same-day triage and call her back.

- HomeCare Companion
